name: bytes
doc:
bytes: the strings functions over []byte, and Buffer.
Functions returning []byte return a new slice unless they say they
share storage (sub-slices of the argument). Case mapping and white
space follow strings (they round-trip through it).

items.name: Buffer
items.doc:
A growable byte buffer: write at the end, read from the front. The
zero value is an empty buffer ready to use. Implements io.Reader
and io.Writer.
items.summary: A growable byte buffer: write at the end, read from the front.
